resolution: Numerical identity is equality of the object assigned to an occurrence. Component inventory and the ordered replacement steps are separately supplied facts; neither entails numerical identity without its bridge. Material is same-components-suffice, not essential parthood, which has the reverse direction. Continued and reassembled occurrence distinction does not itself give bearer distinction. Spatial separation and physical adequacy are not modeled; final bearer distinction is an explicit hypothesis. No inference to substantial unity, soul, grounding direction, or possible-world identity is made.
